journal: Progress in Natural Science: Materials International
title: Preparation of ultrahigh surface area porous carbons templated using zeolite 13X for enhanced hydrogen storage
material_description: FA-ZTC1 | zeolite-13X-templated carbon: zeolite 13X (dried 300 C, 12 h) impregnated by incipient wetness with furfuryl alcohol (printed 'furfural alcohol' in Section 2.1), polymerised under Ar (80 C 24 h, 150 C 8 h), carbonised at 700 C for 3 h under Ar, ethylene CVD (10% in Ar) at 700 C for 3 h, then 900 C for 3 h under Ar; template removed with HF/HCl; heating ramp rate to 700 C: 5 C/min
purification_method: template removal: 10% HF for 24 h, washing, reflux in 36.5% HCl for 6 h; washed with deionised water and dried at 120 C for 12 h
notes: archive: fig7_FA-ZTC1.json. isotherm_point_count is a lower bound: the dense low-pressure markers overlap and cannot be counted (see log.md). BET range: 0.06-0.22. Surface area in parentheses in the table = micropore surface area; micropore-volume method not stated, total pore volume from N2 uptake at P/Po = 0.99 (pore_volume_method = other). Degassing printed as 200 C and 10^-10 bar for 4-6 h (after oven drying 24 h at 80 C); degas_end_pressure_pa converted from 10^-10 bar; duration range not stored. skeletal_density_g_cm3 = 1.5 is the carbon density assumed in the buoyancy correction (adsorbed H2 taken as 0.04 g/cm3), not a measured value. Basis: the Summary calls these uptakes 'total' without defining it (and gives a separate 'excess' 6.2 wt% for FA-ZTC1); basis_inferred = excess by the gravimetric + stated buoyancy-correction default (protocol 3).

purification_method: template removal: 10% HF for 24 h, washing, reflux in 36.5% HCl for 6 h; washed with deionised water and dried at 120 C for 12 h
notes: archive: fig8_C10-FA-ZTC3.json. isotherm_point_count is a lower bound: the dense low-pressure markers overlap and cannot be counted (see log.md). Pore size (PSD maxima, NLDFT) printed as 0.6/1.2 nm (two maxima); average_pore_diameter_nm left empty. BET range: 0.06-0.22. Surface area in parentheses in the table = micropore surface area; micropore-volume method not stated, total pore volume from N2 uptake at P/Po = 0.99 (pore_volume_method = other). Degassing printed as 200 C and 10^-10 bar for 4-6 h (after oven drying 24 h at 80 C); degas_end_pressure_pa converted from 10^-10 bar; duration range not stored. skeletal_density_g_cm3 = 1.5 is the carbon density assumed in the buoyancy correction (adsorbed H2 taken as 0.04 g/cm3), not a measured value. Basis: the Summary calls these uptakes 'total' without defining it (and gives a separate 'excess' 6.2 wt% for FA-ZTC1); basis_inferred = excess by the gravimetric + stated buoyancy-correction default (protocol 3).
